lede: One story surfaced on two feeds at once today: Eva Marie Saint, the actress from 'North by Northwest' and 'On the Waterfront,' has died at 102, carried on both Bluesky and Wikipedia. Everywhere else the web was quiet and workmanlike. Developers pushed a brand new end-to-end testing framework to the top of GitHub trending, and on Steam more than 1.1 million people were inside Counter-Strike 2 at the same moment, still the largest live crowd on the platform.

throughlines.title: Eva Marie Saint, star of 'North by Northwest' and 'On the Waterfront,' dies at 102
throughlines.gist: The day's one cross-feed story, surfacing on Bluesky and Wikipedia together as readers marked the death of an Oscar winning star of Hollywood's golden age.

throughlines.title: tester-army/e2e
throughlines.gist: A new end-to-end testing framework for web and mobile that gained 1,725 stars in a single day to top GitHub trending, a sign developers are still hunting for a cleaner take on the oldest chore in software.

throughlines.title: Sharing AI progress in mathematics
throughlines.gist: OpenAI's post on AI progress in mathematics led Hacker News with 651 points, and its near equal 587 comments point to a room that is arguing the result, not just applauding it.
